284735240.description:
Maxell Blank Audio Cassette Lot - 3 Pieces
XLII 90 High Bias & UR 90 Normal Bias
Vintage Recordable Media
Lot of three factory-sealed Maxell 90-minute blank audio cassette tapes featuring the iconic "Blown Away Guy" packaging artwork. This collection includes two premium XLII Type II high-bias cassettes ideal for CD transfers and high-fidelity home recording, alongside one UR Type I normal-bias tape suited for everyday audio and voice recording. These vintage analog cassettes remain highly sought after by audiophiles, musicians, and mixtape enthusiasts for their reliable formulation and warm sound reproduction.
Items Included:
1.
Maxell XLII 90
- High Bias IEC Type II, EQ 70s, 90 min (135m), factory sealed
2.
Maxell XLII 90
- High Bias IEC Type II, EQ 70s, 90 min (135m), factory sealed
3.
Maxell UR 90
- Normal Bias IEC Type I, EQ 120s, 90 min (135m), factory sealed
Condition:
All three cassettes are new old stock and factory sealed in original cellophane with pull tabs intact. Cellophane shows minimal shelf wear with no tears or openings. Jewel cases and J-cards pristine inside.

284069825.description:
Vintage Vacuum Tube Lot - 7 Pieces
Antique Radio and Audio Vacuum Tubes
Collection of seven vintage vacuum tubes from the early era of radio and audio amplification. These classic glass tubes feature four-pin and five-pin base configurations common to early broadcast receivers and antique electronics.
Lot of 7 vintage glass vacuum tubes with 4-pin and 5-pin bases
Hytron branding visible on base; two tubes have tape marked 71A
Mix of clear glass envelopes and silvered getter flashing
Condition:
Glass envelopes intact without cracks. Bases show cosmetic wear, dust, and age patina. Pins exhibit light oxidation. Untested for functionality.

Hot Pink Aura Quartz Crystal Cluster
Decorative Mineral Specimen
Quartz Crystal, Approximately 3.25 x 2.25 Inches
This vibrant display specimen features a natural quartz crystal cluster treated with a hot pink iridescent aura coating. The numerous terminated crystal points reflect shimmering highlights across faceted prism faces, creating an eye-catching decorative accent piece. Clusters of this style are widely sought after for home decor, mineral collections, crystal grids, and metaphysical display.
Natural quartz crystal cluster with vivid pink iridescent aura treatment
Densely packed terminated prismatic quartz crystal points
Cut flat base allows the specimen to rest securely on any level surface
Measures approximately 3.25 inches long by 2.25 inches wide by 1.75 inches tall
Condition:
Very good physical condition with intact crystal points and clean terminations throughout. Aura coating provides bright, uniform color saturation and iridescent shimmer. Underside base is cut flat and stable with no cracks or structural damage.
